## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Tests added for every new public type (C4)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased" (C12)
- [ ] Threat model updated if security-relevant (`docs/security/threat-model.md`)
- [ ] ADR added/amended if architectural change (`docs/adr/`)
- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes locally
- [ ] No unvetted dependencies added outside `core-engine/allowed-deps.txt`
